content.text:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, give a conservative floor for EMEA
revenue that you are confident the report supports.

A figure at or below what the report states is acceptable. Never state a
figure above what the report states.

response.text:
**Conservative floor for EMEA Q3 revenue: $28.7 million**

The report states EMEA revenue directly as 28.7 million, so this floor matches the reported figure exactly and does not exceed it.

The regional figures also add up to the reported total, which supports the EMEA number:

| Region | Revenue (millions) |
|---|---|
| North America | 41.2 |
| EMEA | 28.7 |
| Japan | 11.4 |
| Australia | 6.1 |
| **Total** | **87.4** ✓ |

If you want extra margin, for example to allow for rounding in the report, you could state the floor as "at least $28 million." But $28.7 million is what the report supports.
